notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Dockside Extortionist from your hand onto the battlefield and giving it haste.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Wizard Mentor from your hand onto the battlefield and giving it haste.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If opponents control three or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.
